16/G.goal: Explain the foundational concepts of XR tracking that determine why tracking is needed, what is tracked, and how tracking systems are implemented.
16/G.achieves: Provides the tracking foundation needed to understand XR hardware and software choices and to progress toward designing or implementing an XR system.

16/O1.goal: Explain the purpose and scope of tracking in XR systems by identifying why tracking is required and what can be tracked.
16/O1.achieves: Gives the learner a basis for understanding XR tracking requirements and user-experience considerations before studying specific tracking technologies.

16/O2.goal: Describe the basic implementation of tracking by distinguishing inside-out from outside-in approaches and outlining the main tracking-process steps.
16/O2.achieves: Helps the learner understand how XR tracking systems operate and prepares them for studying detailed tracking hardware and software.
